// 01   Foundation

Vision & Mission

🔭

Vision

To build a thriving coding culture that empowers students to become innovative problem-solvers, industry-ready developers, and future tech leaders.

🎯

Mission

  • To provide a collaborative platform for students to learn, practice, and excel in programming and emerging technologies
  • To bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world application through hands-on projects and competitions
  • To foster creativity, teamwork, and continuous learning among members
  • To encourage participation in hackathons, coding contests, and technical events
// 02   Direction

Objectives

💻

Conduct regular coding sessions, workshops, and technical talks

🏆

Organize hackathons, coding competitions, and debugging challenges

🔧

Promote project-based learning and innovation

🎯

Support members in preparing for placements and technical interviews

🤝

Create a peer-learning environment through mentorship and knowledge sharing

🌐

Encourage contributions to open-source and real-world problem solving

🏗

Build a strong tech community within the college

// 04   Activities

Events Conducted

EVENT 01 🎨
Logo Design Competition

Club members were asked to design a creative logo for our club, wherein the best logo would become the permanent logo of Adyant Coding Club forever. A creative challenge that gave members the chance to leave a lasting mark on the club's identity.

EVENT 02 🎲
Code Fate

Participants were given a number board (similar to Bingo) on HackerRank, where each number hid a coding problem. Teams solved any 2 questions to qualify. Top teams were shortlisted for the 2nd round, and the top 3 teams were crowned winners!

EVENT 03 🔒
ESCAPE.EXE – Decode. Debug. Escape.

As part of Euphoria, we conducted ESCAPE.EXE, an exciting technical challenge featuring Python, SQL, debugging, coding, and logical problem-solving. The event consisted of two challenging rounds and witnessed enthusiastic participation from students across various external colleges. Participants had to solve the challenges, uncover the secret key, and successfully escape the room!
